mentions.name: Sanbox
mentions.description: Cloud platform for self-improving AI agents where each agent instance gets its own persistent file system, root SSH access, and a web terminal, so agents can build skills through experience rather than starting from scratch on every task. Supports harnesses such as Hermes and Prime Agent, and can be used as a personal assistant, to build an LLM wiki, to connect as part of an agent team, or to run any coding agent on the cloud with dangerously skip permissions. Ongoing work targets a general-purpose agent setup that connects to channels such as email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and Buzz.
mentions.problem: Agents start from scratch on every task instead of building skills with experience.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building cloud managed self improving agents at https://sanbox.cloud.

Each instance gets its own persistent file system, root SSH access and a web terminal. The goal is to let an agent build skills with experience rather than start from scratch on every task.
